youtube.comment: Has a crow ever followed you? 👀 👇

beats.text: Scientists in Seattle put on a creepy mask, and caught a few wild crows.
The birds were tagged and released, completely unharmed.
But the crows remembered that face.
For years, crows scolded and dive-bombed anyone wearing that mask.
Even crows that were never caught joined in. Young crows learned it from their parents.
People in a neutral mask? Mostly ignored.
So be nice to crows. They're keeping score.
